discoveries.statement: In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale is strictly proper (Rothenberg)  ⇒  it has no two single steps in a row
In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale is a deep scale  ⇒  it is inversionally symmetric

rediscoveries.statement: In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale is generated by a single interval  ⇒  it is inversionally symmetric
rediscoveries.known: elementary: {0, g, …, (k−1)g} is symmetric under j ↦ k−1−j

rediscoveries.statement: In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale has Myhill's property  ⇒  it is generated by a single interval
In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale is maximally even  ⇒  it is proper (Rothenberg)
rediscoveries.known: maximally even sets are proper (Clough & Douthett 1991)

rediscoveries.statement: In every N-note equal temperament (5 ≤ N ≤ 16): a scale is maximally even  ⇒  it is inversionally symmetric
